title: Normalization from .csv
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Create normalization CSV
steps.instruction: Create a CSV file (including the header line) with columns: source plate well, destination plate well, volume sample (µl), volume diluent (µl). List each transfer on a separate line; empty lines are ignored. Example line: A1, A1, 2, 28. Download the example CSV from the provided link if needed.

steps.title: Gather required labware
steps.instruction: Obtain the following labware: Eppendorf™ 96‑Well twin.tec™ PCR Plate (250 µl), NEST 12‑channel reservoir (15 ml) or USA Scientific 12‑Well Reservoir (22 ml), Opentrons 20 µl and 300 µl tipracks, Opentrons P20 and P300 GEN2 single‑channel pipettes, and P10 and P50 GEN1 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Load reservoir with water
steps.instruction: Place the NEST 12‑channel reservoir in slot 1 of the OT‑2 deck. Fill channel 1 of the reservoir with water to be used for dilution.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Place the source PCR plate, destination PCR plate, tipracks, and any other labware on the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Specify pipette mounts
steps.instruction: In the protocol setup, input the path to the normalization CSV file and indicate the mount side (left or right) for the P10 and P50 GEN1 single‑channel pipettes.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the Opentrons App, calibrate all labware, tipracks, and pipettes as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Run normalization protocol
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol; the robot will transfer the specified sample volume from each source well to the corresponding destination well and add the indicated diluent volume of water from the reservoir.
